overallStatus.text: 🔴 OFF TRACK — 100% FKP adoption in FY27 is no longer mathematically feasible

executiveSummary.bottomLine: Confirmed migrations shifting into FY28 (CDP, MonCloud BJ-A) have capped our maximum achievable FY27 adoption. To hit even these revised ceilings, teams must still close three critical timeline gaps (see Critical Actions Required below).
executiveSummary.keyChange: CDP Control Plane: Schedule revised from FY27 Q4 → FY28 Q1. (Note: CDP retains Q4 as a stretch goal; if achieved, it will boost Commercial/Gia2h projections by ~5%).

rebaseline.description: FKP leadership is evaluating a V2MOM metric rebaseline (revising the target to 90%) to accurately reflect confirmed FY28 timelines. Without this adjustment, FY27 will flag as off track despite teams achieving maximum feasible progress.

recentWins: AI Platform legacy EKS clusters decommissioned! The AI Platform (Notebooks and CCP use cases) successfully decommissioned their legacy EKS clusters. They are now fully on FKP!

MC Einstein services decommissioned! The remaining 27 MC Einstein services have been decommissioned. This completes the FKP adoption efforts for Marketing Cloud, who is now showing 100% FKP adoption across Ramesh Ragineni’s org. Well done!

Deprecation progress continues: In addition to MC Einstein services, 8 other services were deprecated in the last 2 weeks. 84 services now remain on a path to deprecation, down from a high of 144 in May.
Commercial and Gia2h adoption improving: Commercial increased from 76.5% → 77.6% (+1.1%), Gia2h from 75.1% → 76.9% (+1.8%) since the June 11 report.
